deck: Sketchy Pharm::5 GI & Endocrine::4 Hypothalamic & Pituitary::4.2 - ADH, DDAVP,& ADH Receptor Antagonists

question.text: Other than increasing water permeability, what physiologic function does stimulation of V2 receptor mediate?

answer.text:
(1) ↑ vWF
(2) ↑ Factor VIII

(Remember vWF stabilizes Factor VIII, preventing its degradation, so it's logical they would be affected together)
